notes.title: Hotfix 13.1
notes.notes:
So despite the giant leap in hotfix numbers (I've changed it so they correlate to the build number), this is a fix for Save Game slots not showing when pressing load game.

As long as the save you started was on the last path (so after November 19th) you should be able to open saves again now. Thanks for letting us know.

Best,

Harry
Antler Studios

notes.title: Hotfix 10.4
notes.notes: Some users have reported the winch not working properly when loading a save inside the airship. I've added a lever next to it which can be used to call the winch up.

notes.title: Hotfix 10.3
notes.notes: Afternoon everyone, I've just pushed a hotfix which should prevent the crash occurring when interacting with the bed/faxophone. The 'actual' issue still isn't fixed but in short the bug is caused by not having a potion equipped, so for now you can no longer unequipped the potion :sweat_smile:  If you are loading a save where you didn't have the Bubblate potion equipped, please do so before interacting with offending bed/machine.
